scripts.text:
DELETE FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP WHERE AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) FROM D360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP);

INSERT INTO EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP
(
AS_OF_DATE
,ACID
,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM
,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
,ACCT_POA_AS_NAME
,ACCT_POA_AS_DESIG
,ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS
,ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD
,START_DATE
,END_DATE
,LCHG_USER_ID
,LCHG_TIME
,RCRE_USER_ID
,RCRE_TIME
,CUST_ID
,CUST_RELTN_CODE
,PASS_SHEET_FLG
,SI_FLG
,TD_MATRTY_FLG
,LOAN_OVRDUE_FLG
,NMA_KEY_TYPE
,NMA_KEY_ID
,DEL_FLG
,MODE_OF_DESPATCH
,TS_CNT
,SCHM_TYPE
,XCLUDE_FOR_COMB_STMT
,STMT_CUST_ID
,INT_ADV_FLG
,INTCERT_PRINT_FLG
,GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT
,GUARANTOR_LIAB_SEQ
,INTRADAY_STMNT_REQD
,BANK_ID
,CUST_PHONE_TYPE
,CUST_EMAIL_TYPE
,RELATED_PARTY_TYPE
,PROFIT_CERT_FLG
,PREF_LANG_CODE
,PREF_LANG_ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS
,ALT1_ACCT_POA_AS_NAME
,RPARTY_STMT_PRNT_CHRG_FLG
,RPARTY_RGLR_STMT_CHRG_ID
,RPARTY_DUP_STMT_CHRG_ID
,WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE
,WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE
,WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE
,TAX_CERT_NUM
,TAX_FORM_PARTICULARS
,TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE
,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
,TAX_EVENT
,REQUESTED_BY
,TAX_EVENT_REASON_CODE
,TAX_MARKER
,CORP_REP_CIF_ID
,MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG
,CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG
,REASON_FOR_RELEASE
,isActive
,isLatest
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
,ACID
,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM
,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
,ACCT_POA_AS_NAME
,ACCT_POA_AS_DESIG
,ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS
,convert(numeric(20,4),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD,' ',''),''),0)) as ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,START_DATE),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as START_DATE
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,END_DATE),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as END_DATE
,LCHG_USER_ID
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as LCHG_TIME
,RCRE_USER_ID
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as RCRE_TIME
,CUST_ID
,CUST_RELTN_CODE
,PASS_SHEET_FLG
,SI_FLG
,TD_MATRTY_FLG
,LOAN_OVRDUE_FLG
,NMA_KEY_TYPE
,NMA_KEY_ID
,DEL_FLG
,MODE_OF_DESPATCH
,convert(numeric(5,0),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(TS_CNT,' ',''),''),0)) as TS_CNT
,SCHM_TYPE
,XCLUDE_FOR_COMB_STMT
,STMT_CUST_ID
,INT_ADV_FLG
,INTCERT_PRINT_FLG
,convert(numeric(9,6),ISNULL(NULLIF(REPLACE(GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT,' ',''),''),0)) as GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT
,GUARANTOR_LIAB_SEQ
,INTRADAY_STMNT_REQD
,BANK_ID
,CUST_PHONE_TYPE
,CUST_EMAIL_TYPE
,RELATED_PARTY_TYPE
,PROFIT_CERT_FLG
,PREF_LANG_CODE
,PREF_LANG_ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS
,ALT1_ACCT_POA_AS_NAME
,RPARTY_STMT_PRNT_CHRG_FLG
,RPARTY_RGLR_STMT_CHRG_ID
,RPARTY_DUP_STMT_CHRG_ID
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE
,TAX_CERT_NUM
,TAX_FORM_PARTICULARS
,ISNULL(convert(datetime2,TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE),'1900-01-01T00:00:00.000') as TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE
,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
,TAX_EVENT
,REQUESTED_BY
,TAX_EVENT_REASON_CODE
,TAX_MARKER
,CORP_REP_CIF_ID
,MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG
,CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG
,REASON_FOR_RELEASE
,1 as isActive
,1 as isLatest
,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP
WHERE H = 'D'
--AND CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) >= convert(DATE, stuff(stuff(stuff(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':'))
